biological.citation: Garcia-Beltran et al. 2016 - HLA-F and MHC-I open conformers (OCs) bind KIR3DS1 (PMID: 27649529)
biological.summary: Surface plasmon resonance, pull-down and heterodimerization assays showed that HLA-F and other MHC-I open conformers physically bind KIR3DS1 but not KIR3DL1. HLA-F immobilized on surfaces increased granule exocytosis in activated KIR3DS1+ cells, indicating a functional response.

biological.citation: HLA-F and MHC class I open conformers are ligands for NK cell Ig-like receptors (PMID: 24018270)
biological.summary: Peptide-free HLA-F open conformer physically and functionally interacts with KIR3DL2 and KIR2DS4. Classical MHC-I open conformers also act as KIR ligands, suggesting an immunoregulatory role in inflammation.

biological.citation: HLA-F and MHC-I open conformers cooperate in a MHC-I antigen cross-presentation pathway (PMID: 23851683)
biological.summary: HLA-F and MHC-I open conformers on activated lymphocytes and monocytes mediate cross-presentation of exogenous antigen. This pathway is TAP- and tapasin-independent, sensitive to lysosomal enzyme inhibitors, and depends on allotype-specific epitope recognition.

biological.citation: Interactions Between KIR3DS1 and HLA-F Activate Natural Killer Cells to Control HCV Replication in Cell Culture (PMID: 30031767)
biological.summary: HLA-F is up-regulated on HCV-infected cells in culture, in humanized-liver mice and in primary liver tissue. KIR3DS1-HLA-F interaction contributes to NK cell-mediated control of HCV replication.

biological.citation: HLA-F transcriptional and protein differential expression according to its genetic polymorphisms (PMID: 37166140)
biological.summary: SNPs rs1362126, rs2523405 and rs2523393 near HLA-F or in HLA-F-AS1 were associated with HLA-F expression, with the largest effect sizes and a double-dose effect. This was shown in 1000 Genomes RNAseq and by Q-PCR and intracellular cytometry in PBMC. Allele frequencies differ across geographic populations.
biological.sample_size: 1000 Genomes samples plus healthy donor PBMC

biological.citation: Endometrial HLA-F expression is influenced by genotypes and correlates differently with immune cell infiltration in IVF and recurrent implantation failure patients (PMID: 35689445)
biological.summary: HLA-F protein is expressed in mid-secretory endometrium and endometrial stromal cells. Levels vary with HLA-F SNP genotypes and diplotypes, and correlate with CD163+ M2 macrophage and CD56+ uNK cell infiltration and with plasma progesterone.
biological.sample_size: 85 RIF women, 36 IVF controls; 5 primary ESC cultures

biological.citation: Correlation of alteration of HLA-F expression and clinical characterization in 593 brain glioma samples (PMID: 30755240)
biological.summary: High HLA-F expression correlated with poorer overall survival in glioma and GBM. It was enriched in GBM, IDH1 wild-type and mesenchymal subtype tumors, and correlated with other HLA class I molecules.
biological.significance: Kaplan-Meier survival association (p-value not given in abstract)

biological.citation: HLA-F expression is a prognostic factor in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer (PMID: 21561677)
biological.summary: HLA-F was detected by IHC in 24.1% of NSCLC lesions but not in adjacent normal lung. Positive expression was an independent poor prognostic factor (HR 5.12).

biological.citation: Human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-E and HLA-F expression in gastric cancer (PMID: 25862890)
biological.summary: HLA-F was expressed on the cell membrane of gastric cancer cells. Expression correlated with depth of invasion, nodal, lymphatic and venous invasion, and with poorer five-year survival, especially in combination with HLA-E.

biological.citation: ASHG 2018 - Illuminating the dark genome: Evaluation of technologies to assess medically relevant dark spots
biological.summary: A polymorphic 2.6 kbp deletion upstream of HLA-F was identified. RNA-Seq showed it correlates with HLA-F expression level and exon usage.
